subject: English Grammar
domain: Tenses, Active & Passive Voice, and Direct & Indirect Speech
description: Comprehensive English grammar covering parts of speech, subject-verb agreement rules, active and passive voice transformations, direct and indirect speech, and tense conjugations.
portions: Unit 1.1: Parts of Speech & Subject-Verb Agreement Rules
Unit 1.2: Present, Past & Future Tense Forms & Conjugation
Unit 1.3: Active Voice and Passive Voice Transformations
Unit 1.4: Direct Speech and Reported (Indirect) Speech Conversion
learning_objectives: LO-1: Identify and apply correct parts of speech and subject-verb agreement rules.
LO-2: Transform sentences between Active Voice and Passive Voice correctly.
LO-3: Convert direct speech sentences into indirect reported speech.
LO-4: Identify tense errors and rectify sentence syntax.

subject: English Grammar
description: Understanding modal verbs, relative and subordinate clauses, punctuation rules, vocabulary enhancement, and paragraph composition.
portions: Unit 2.1: Modal Auxiliaries (Can, Could, May, Might, Must, Should)
Unit 2.2: Types of Clauses (Main, Relative, Subordinate Clauses)
Unit 2.3: Punctuation Rules, Capitalization & Paragraph Composition
learning_objectives: LO-1: Apply modal auxiliaries to express permission, obligation, and possibility.
LO-2: Construct complex sentences using relative and subordinate clauses.
LO-3: Apply standard punctuation marks and capitalization in composition.

subject: Physics
domain: Force, Pressure & Newton's Laws of Motion
description: Understanding Newton's laws of motion, force equations (F=ma), static friction, atmospheric pressure, gravitational acceleration, and physical mechanics.
portions: Unit 2.1: Newton's Laws of Motion & Equations of Motion (F=ma, v=u+at)
Unit 2.2: Types of Contact & Non-contact Forces
Unit 2.3: Static, Kinetic, and Rolling Friction Mechanisms
Unit 2.4: Atmospheric Pressure, Hydraulics & Gravitational Acceleration
learning_objectives: LO-1: Apply Newton's laws to calculate acceleration and force (F=ma).
LO-2: Calculate pressure using force per unit area formula.
LO-3: Demonstrate methods to reduce friction in physical machinery.
LO-4: Explain Pascal's principle in hydraulic systems.

subject: Biology
description: Understanding photosynthesis, chloroplast structure, light and dark reactions, plant nutrition, and essential minerals in Tamil Nadu agricultural ecosystems.
portions: Unit 1.1: Leaf Anatomy and Chloroplast Structure
Unit 1.2: Mechanism of Photosynthesis (Light & Dark Reactions)
Unit 1.3: Factors Influencing Photosynthetic Rate (Light Intensity, CO2, Temp)
Unit 1.4: Plant Nutrition & Mineral Translocation in Regional Crops
learning_objectives: LO-1: Explain the chemical equation of photosynthesis and raw materials required.
LO-2: Differentiate between light-dependent and light-independent cellular reactions.
LO-3: Analyze the role of stomata in transpiration and gas exchange.
LO-4: Conduct starch test experiment to demonstrate light requirement in leaves.

subject: Biology
description: Structure and physiology of human digestive, respiratory, and circulatory systems with focus on nutrition and health in regional contexts.
portions: Unit 3.1: Alimentary Canal and Digestive Enzymes
Unit 3.2: Mechanism of Respiration and Gas Exchange
Unit 3.3: Blood Composition and Heart Structure
learning_objectives: LO-1: Trace the path of food digestion from mouth to small intestine.
LO-2: Describe the role of hemoglobin in oxygen transportation.

subject: Mathematics
description: Cost calculations, practical multiplication in daily life, solving linear equations, factorising algebraic expressions, and solving real-life word problems.
portions: Unit 4.1: Cost Calculation & Practical Multiplication (Total Cost = Quantity x Rate)
Unit 4.2: Linear Equations in One Variable & Word Problems
Unit 4.3: Algebraic Identities, Expansion & Factorisation
learning_objectives: LO-1: Calculate total cost using multiplication formulas (Total Cost = Number of Items x Cost per Item).
LO-2: Solve linear equations with fractional coefficients and practical applications.
LO-3: Apply (a+b)^2 and (a-b)^2 identities to simplify expressions.

subject: Mathematics
description: Properties of triangles, Pythagoras theorem, area and perimeter of plane figures (trapezium, rhombus), and volume of 3D solids.
portions: Unit 5.1: Construction of Triangles & Quadrilaterals
Unit 5.2: Pythagoras Theorem & Right-Angled Triangle Applications
Unit 5.3: Mensuration: Area of Quadrilaterals, Trapezium & Rhombus
Unit 5.4: Volume & Surface Area of Cubes and Cuboids
learning_objectives: LO-1: Apply Pythagoras theorem to calculate unknown lengths in right-angled triangles.
LO-2: Calculate area and perimeter of composite 2D geometric shapes.
LO-3: Determine surface area and volume of rectangular prisms and cubes.

subject: Mathematics
domain: Rational Numbers & Linear Equations in One Variable
description: Properties of rational numbers, representation on number line, solving linear equations with variables on both sides, and applications.
portions: Unit 1.1: Rational Numbers: Closure, Commutativity & Associativity Properties
Unit 1.2: Representation of Rational Numbers on Number Line & Finding Rational Numbers Between Two Numbers
Unit 1.3: Linear Equations with Variables on Both Sides
Unit 1.4: Word Problems & Practical Applications of Linear Equations
learning_objectives: LO-1: Identify and apply algebraic properties of rational numbers.
LO-2: Solve multi-step linear equations involving fractional terms.
LO-3: Translate real-world scenarios into linear algebraic equations.

subject: Mathematics
description: Organizing data, bar graphs, pie charts, probability concepts, square numbers, square roots by prime factorisation and division methods.

Unit 2.2: Circle Graphs or Pie Charts Construction
Unit 2.3: Chance and Probability Basics
Unit 2.4: Squares, Square Roots, Cubes & Cube Roots Calculation
learning_objectives: LO-1: Construct and interpret pie charts and histograms from raw frequency data.
LO-2: Calculate empirical probability of events.
LO-3: Compute square roots and cube roots using prime factorisation and long division.

subject: Mathematics
description: Percentage calculations, profit and loss, simple and compound interest, discount, tax calculations, and arithmetic sequences.

Unit 1.2: Simple Interest & Compound Interest Formulae
Unit 1.3: Percentages and Tax Calculations (GST)
Unit 1.4: Direct and Inverse Proportions
learning_objectives: LO-1: Calculate percentage profit, loss, and marked price discounts.
LO-2: Compute compound interest annually and half-yearly.
LO-3: Solve problems involving direct and inverse variation.

subject: Mathematics
description: Exponents and powers, laws of exponents, algebraic expressions, multiplication of polynomials, and factorisation strategies.

Unit 1.3: Factorisation using Standard Identities & Regrouping

LO-2: Factorise algebraic expressions by splitting middle terms and standard identities.

subject: Mathematics
description: Area calculation of regular and irregular polygons, quadrilaterals, circles, and solving systems of linear equations.
portions: Unit 1.1: Area of Polygons and Quadrilaterals
Unit 1.2: Circle Properties: Circumference and Area Calculation
Unit 1.3: Algebraic Equations & Equal Relations
learning_objectives: LO-1: Calculate area of polygons by dividing into triangles and trapeziums.
LO-2: Derive and apply circumference and area formulas for circles.

subject: Social Studies

Unit 5.3: Maritime Trade and Kaveri Delta Irrigation

LO-2: Identify Chola bronze art and temple architectural features.

LO-2: Compare traditional and modern water conservation irrigation methods.

subject: Biology

Unit 2.3: Food Preservation Methods (Pasteurization, Salting)

subject: Physics

Unit 1.3: Hydroelectric Power Generation in Sharavathi Basins

subject: Biology

Unit 2.3: Plant Cell vs Animal Cell Comparison
